game: Hot Shots Tennis: Get a Grip
approach: General PSP static recompiler: game code translated ahead of time to C, linked with a native runtime and a Vulkan player. This is its first maintainer-tested title.
notes: Part of the Nakagawa family. Bring your own copy of the game: nothing is downloaded, and no game data, keys or firmware are included. Other PSP titles are Experimental or Untested until the maintainer tests them. Contributions welcome.
